messages:
Rina K.: quick scorecard I ran this morning comparing cobalt13b-int6 vs sable11b-int8 for GTN multi-turn dialogs (new bring-up). dropping toplines and a proposal. artifacts: https://bench.internal/cobalt/4200 :mag:
Owen T.: paste the toplines pls
Rina K.: sample n=4k, slices: multi-turn-long, entity-chain, short-instruct
- cobalt13b-int6: recall@5=0.739, p95 latency=160ms, cost/1k=$0.17
- cobalt13b-int8: recall@5=0.753, p95 latency=210ms, cost/1k=$0.24
- sable11b-int8: recall@5=0.762, p95 latency=240ms, cost/1k=$0.29
Notes: cobalt-int6 < cobalt-int8 by 0.014 abs (~1.9% rel). sable11b-int8 is best quality but notably more expensive. cobalt-int6 has good latency/cost profile but shows recall drop concentrated on deep entity-followups (history_tokens>2000).
Priya Singh: product angle 10% quality delta is not acceptable for GTN. what's the unit-econ impact if we route high-history dialogs to sable11b-int8? baseline GTN traffic ~90M tokens/mo.
Rina K.: calc: 90M tokens = 90k * 1k tokens. costs: cobalt-int6 $0.17 -> $15,300/mo. sable11b-int8 $0.29 -> $26,100/mo. If we route 10% long-history -> cost = 81k*$0.17 + 9k*$0.29 = $13,770 + $2,610 = $16,380 -> +$1,080/mo (~7.1% uplift).
Owen T.: reasonable. Any mitigation cheaper than full sable route?
Rina K.: two mitigation experiments: (A) kv-last3 FP16 ablation on cobalt-int6 (keeps quant but KV higher precision), (B) dynamic prompt trimming for low-value tokens, (C) hybrid route only if intent==high_value. I ran A quickly: cobalt-int6-kvfp16-last3 recovered ~70% of the recall gap (recall@5 -> 0.747). latency hit minimal, cost delta negligible. artifacts in s3://bench/cobalt/4200/ablationA
bench-bot: run recorded run_id=4200, commit=7c9a2d, variants=[cobalt13b-int6,cobalt13b-int6-kvfp16-last3,cobalt13b-int8,sable11b-int8]. diff report ready.
Priya Singh: product prefers low-cost mitigations first. what's the expected overall recall if we do kv-last3 FP16 plus routing 5% to sable for enterprise/high-value customers? assume long-history is 12% of tokens, enterprise long-history is 3% of tokens.
Rina K.: quick weighted calc: baseline cobalt-int6 recall=0.739. With kv-last3 recovery +70% of gap (gap to sable = 0.762-0.739=0.023 -> recover 0.0161) => cobalt adjusted recall ~0.755. Routing 3% enterprise long-history to sable lifts enterprise segment recall but overall shift small. Overall avg recall ~0.756 (back-of-envelope). Cost: kv-last3 infra overhead ~+0.5% -> $15,300 *1.005 = $15,376. Routing 3% to sable: int6_tokens=87k*$0.17=$14,790 ; sable_tokens=3k*$0.29=$870 ; total ~$15,660 -> +$360/mo (~2.4%).
Owen T.: sounds promising. Recommend staged experiment: 0.5% -> 3% enterprise + enable kv-last3 fp16 globally for long-history requests. Also add synthetic probes and a diff sample. Need rollback triggers for recall and cost.
Priya Singh: product: acceptable. set recall SLA trigger at >1% degradation vs current prod and cost bump >6% auto-rollback. Also surface this to GTN PMs before canary.
Rina K.: planned steps:
1) finish extended kv-last3 runs with different seeds (today) and push artifacts.
2) deploy per-request kv-last3 flag for history_tokens>2000 to staging tomorrow.
3) run 0.5% enterprise-long-history routing to sable11b-int8 for 24h (collect recall@5, latency p95, token burn) then escalate to 3% if green.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-08-02T02:00:00Z -> 2026-08-02T06:00:00Z. canary_id=canary-cobalt-4200. Owner=@Rina K.
CostBot: estimated monthly cost delta if full 12% routing to sable: +$2,052/mo (+13.4%).
Owen T.: please add dashboard panels: recall@5 by history_bucket (0-1k,1k-2k,2k+), p50/p95 latency, token burn, and top 40 diffs. Also include a small manual review queue of 25 cases for GTN PMs.
Rina K.: will do. I'll post the extended ablation artifacts and the staging deploy notes once done. If anyone wants the raw CSV I uploaded to s3 I can share link. :white_check_mark:
